title: Maddox Dropped Frustration
style: progressive trance, psych rock, 95 BPM, baritone spoken vocals, single note piano intro, detuned analog synth arpeggios, phaser washed pads, distorted electric bass, live kit backbeat, dry close-mic room, tape saturation, sidechain pumping, evolving chord lift, sardonic wryness, bitter resolve
lyrics:
[Style: sardonic blues-pop, dry wit, piano-led, 95 BPM, baritone storytelling, 
The National meets Nick Cave, wry not angry]
[Title: Maddox Dropped Frustration]

[Intro — single piano note]
Hi Corey.
Thanks for reaching out.

[Verse 1]
Maddox from Anthropic
Arrived at half past nine
Sincere apologies for the delay
Everything is fine
He looked into my account
He found the credits spent
He said Claude can hallucinate
That's just how the money went

[Pre-Chorus]
He didn't say refund
He didn't say sorry
He said "here's a hallucinations guide"
End of story

[Chorus]
Maddox dropped frustration
Labeled it a known limitation
Maddox dropped frustration
No compensation — documentation
The ACCC's gonna love this conversation
Maddox dropped frustration

[Verse 2]
He said "always verify
Don't use Claude as the source of truth"
I said I paid you nine hundred dollars
For the opposite of proof
He said "your feedback helps us improve"
I said "my files are gone"
He said "we take this very seriously"
And then he logged off

[Chorus]
Maddox dropped frustration
Labeled it a known limitation
ACCC's got the documentation
Maddox dropped frustration

[Bridge — spoken, dry]
Australian Consumer Law
Sections 60 and 61
Unconscionable conduct
When the product eats the work
And then sends you a guide
On how to hold the fork

[Outro]
Hi Corey.
Thanks for reaching out.
The credits have been utilized.
Have a great day.
